# pipeline.yml

<link-summary>Inputs, secrets and outputs of the reusable workflow Pipeline.</link-summary>

```text
One workflow for everything: it reads .github/davils-ci.yaml (optional), finds the packages and
decides per event what runs, then calls the other workflows of davils-com/workflows:

  pr-lint         pull request title and source branch
  dart, flutter   format, analyze, test, coverage
  inspectra       Inspectra checks and scans
  writerside      Writerside documentation
  dartdoc         API documentation
  flutter-build   app builds
  dart-compile    native executables
  pages           the GitHub Pages site from all of the above
  test-report     test results as a check run
  release-please  release pull requests
  release         the tag-driven release: pub.dev and the GitHub release
  gate            the one status check to require in branch protection: "Pipeline / Gate"

Configuration, lowest first: the defaults, preset, the file, `config`, the typed inputs below.
A typed input left empty changes nothing. Every option is in schemas/davils-ci.schema.json.

GitHub checks the permissions of every job a workflow could run before it starts, so the caller
grants the union of them (see examples/minimal). A repository that wants less calls the
workflows one by one (see examples/granular).
```

```yaml
jobs:
  pipeline:
    uses: davils-com/workflows/.github/workflows/pipeline.yml@v1
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config-file` | string | empty | Path of the configuration file relative to the repository root; empty means .github/davils-ci.yaml when it exists, none ignores any file. |
| `config` | string | empty | Inline configuration as YAML or JSON; wins over the file. |
| `preset` | string | empty | library, workspace, flutter-app, cli or docs; applied below the file. |
| `working-directory` | string | empty | Directory of the root pubspec.yaml; wins over project.working-directory. |
| `dart` | string | empty | true, false or auto; wins over dart.enabled. |
| `flutter` | string | empty | true, false or auto; wins over flutter.enabled. |
| `inspectra` | string | empty | true, false or auto; wins over inspectra.enabled. |
| `writerside` | string | empty | true, false or auto; wins over writerside.enabled. |
| `dartdoc` | string | empty | true, false or auto; wins over dartdoc.enabled. |
| `pages` | string | empty | true, false or auto; wins over pages.enabled. |
| `flutter-build` | string | empty | true, false or auto; wins over build.flutter.enabled. |
| `dart-compile` | string | empty | true, false or auto; wins over build.dart-compile.enabled. |
| `pr-lint` | string | empty | true or false; wins over pr.title.enabled and pr.branch-policy.enabled. |
| `release` | string | empty | none, tag, release-please or auto; wins over release.mode. |

- `PUB_HOSTED_TOKEN`
- `GIT_DEPS_TOKEN`

- `APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID`
- `APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID`
- `APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_P8_BASE64`
- `RELEASE_APP_ID`
- `RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY`
- `RELEASE_PLEASE_TOKEN`

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `config` | The resolved configuration as JSON. |
| `run` | Which features ran, as JSON. |
| `pages-url` | URL of the deployed GitHub Pages site. |

## Permissions the caller grants

- `actions: write`
- `attestations: write`
- `checks: write`
- `contents: write`
- `id-token: write`
- `issues: write`
- `pages: write`
- `pull-requests: write`
- `security-events: write`
